title: 24th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/24/1/2025).
First reading of a government bill, sponsored by Kinbidhoo MP Ali Ashraq, to amend the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010).

Preliminary debate on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to gauge members' views on the Chair acting in ways that obstruct the Majlis's work, contrary to the Constitution and the Standing Orders.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Housing Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu Central MP Asma Rasheed.
Report of the Rules Committee on the matter of extending the period for regulations listed in Schedules 1 and 2 of the General Regulations Act (Law No. 6/2008).
Report of the Finance Committee on Housing Development Corporation Limited not receiving rent owed to it for land and buildings leased to various parties for business.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced a Tobacco Control Act amendment, opened debate on a resolution criticising the Chair's conduct, continued the Housing Bill, and took up committee reports on extending regulation deadlines and on unpaid rent owed to HDC.
